title: Focus iOS interfaces on primary tasks and content

statement.en: Help people focus on primary iOS tasks and content by limiting onscreen controls.
statement.ja: onscreen controlを絞り、iOSのprimary taskとcontentへ集中できるようにする。

conditions: Keep secondary details and actions discoverable with minimal interaction.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Designing for iOS experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるDesigning for iOSの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “Help people focus on primary iOS tasks and content by limiting onscreen controls.” in the documented Designing for iOS context?

positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.

source.evidence_paraphrase: Help people focus on primary iOS tasks and content by limiting onscreen controls.

portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.

title: Adapt iOS interfaces to appearance changes

statement.en: Adapt iOS interfaces seamlessly to orientation, Dark Mode, and Dynamic Type changes.
statement.ja: iOS interfaceをorientation、Dark Mode、Dynamic Typeの変化へseamlessに適応させる。

conditions: Let people choose the configurations that work best for them.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Designing for iOS experience on the scoped Apple platforms.

title: Support comfortable iPhone holding patterns

statement.en: Support iOS interactions that accommodate how people usually hold iPhone.
statement.ja: iPhoneの一般的な持ち方に合うiOS interactionをsupportする。

conditions: Place frequently reached controls near the middle or bottom of the display when appropriate.
Provide comfortable swipe access for back navigation and list-row actions.

title: Integrate permissioned iOS platform information

statement.en: With people’s permission, integrate iOS platform information to enhance the experience without requiring manual data entry.
statement.ja: 人のpermissionを得てiOS platform情報を統合し、manual data entryなしで体験を向上させる。

conditions: Request and use information only with explicit permission.
Examples include payments, biometric authentication, and location-based features.
